stories.headline: Goyal says Indian goods will pay lower US tariffs than rivals under trade deal
stories.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal, speaking in Cairo, says the US has agreed to give Indian goods preferential access, with lower duties than competing countries. He says this was settled when PM Modi and President Trump agreed the framework for a bilateral trade agreement. Both sides aim to close the first part of the deal by the end of this financial year, in March 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: Lower US duties than rivals would help Indian exporters such as textiles, engineering and pharma win orders in their biggest market.
stories.note: Tariff rates and product lists not given; the lower-duty promise is Goyal's account of the talks.

image.alt: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal speaking at a podium (file photo)

impact.why: Lower US duties than rivals would help export-heavy firms win orders.
A firmer trade deal could support export earnings and foreign inflows.

stories.headline: Update: IMD says Bay depression may become a severe cyclone heading for Andhra coast
stories.summary: The low-pressure area has strengthened into a depression over the southeast Bay of Bengal. IMD says it is likely to become a cyclonic storm on Monday and a severe cyclonic storm over the west-central Bay on Tuesday, then move northwest towards the Andhra Pradesh coast. A pre-cyclone watch is out for Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha, and fishermen are told to stay off the sea.
stories.why_it_matters: It would be the third cyclone to cross the Andhra coast in about 20 days, threatening crops, ports and power lines.
stories.note: Changed since morning: now a depression, forecast to become a severe cyclonic storm by Tuesday with an Andhra track.

stories.headline: Amit Shah says revived Pune heavy engineering co-op will restart by December 2027
stories.summary: Cooperation Minister Amit Shah laid the foundation for reviving the National Heavy Engineering Cooperative in Pune, shut for about 11 years. Backed by NDDB, Amul, IFFCO, NCDC and NAFED, it will make machinery for sugar mills, dairies, ethanol and bio-gas plants, plus railway and defence equipment. Shah also launched the driver-owned Bharat Taxi service in Pune.

stories.headline: Zelenskyy says Starshield speed limits are helping Russia hit Ukraine's power grid
stories.summary: Zelenskyy says speed limits on SpaceX's military Starshield terminals have lasted five days and are weakening Ukraine's drone defences; Starlink denies restricting speeds. Overnight, a strike on an Odesa energy site cut power to 41,000 homes, energy firm DTEK says, and Ukraine's army says it downed 106 of 132 Russian drones.
stories.why_it_matters: Ukraine relies on Starshield links for interceptor drones, so the dispute hits its defence as US-brokered ceasefire talks stall.
stories.note: Claim by Zelenskyy; Starlink denies restricting speeds. Speed limits also reported by Euronews on Nov 12.

image.alt: A Ukrainian soldier prepares a fixed-wing drone for launch in Zaporizhia region

stories.headline: Update: Iran calls Bahrain strikes defensive; Bahrain, Jordan and Egypt condemn them
stories.summary: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said Sunday's attacks on Riffa Air Base were purely defensive and aimed only at US forces, accusing Gulf states of helping US strikes on Iran. Bahrain's foreign ministry holds Iran fully responsible, and Jordan and Egypt condemned the attacks. Bahrain says its defences intercepted them; the US military has not commented on Sunday's attack.
stories.why_it_matters: Repeated Iranian fire at a Gulf host of US forces raises the risk of a wider war around Hormuz oil routes.
stories.note: New since midday: Iran's official defence of the strikes and regional condemnation. Damage claims are not independently confirmed.

impact.why: More Iranian fire on Gulf bases keeps a risk premium on crude.

stories.headline: 49th ASEAN summit opens in Manila; Modi to join ASEAN-India talks on Tuesday
stories.summary: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. opened the three-day summit calling for regional unity on security and economic risks. PM Modi visits the Philippines on November 16-17 and attends the ASEAN-India and East Asia summits on the 17th, when Singapore takes over the ASEAN chair.

stories.headline: Cape Verde votes for president; first woman candidate challenges incumbent Neves
stories.summary: About 300,000 voters choose among six candidates, including President José Maria Neves seeking a second term and former justice minister Joana Rosa, the first woman to run since 1975. A run-off on November 29 follows if no one tops 50%; results are due in two to three days.
stories.note: Single source: Al Jazeera (with AP and Reuters).

stories.headline: India and Egypt central banks working on trade in rupees and Egyptian pounds
stories.summary: Piyush Goyal says the RBI and Egypt's central bank are working to let the two countries settle trade in their own currencies. At the seventh Joint Trade Committee in Cairo, the sides agreed to draft terms for a trade agreement, and Goyal proposed linking UPI with Egypt's payment systems.
stories.why_it_matters: Settling more trade in rupees cuts dollar demand and is part of India's push to internationalise its currency.

image.alt: Piyush Goyal meets an Egyptian minister in Cairo, Indian and Egyptian flags between them

impact.why: Rupee trade settlement slightly trims dollar demand over time.

stories.headline: Bitcoin hits four-month low near $62,100 as $2 billion in bets are wiped out
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to about $62,100 in Asian trade on Sunday, its lowest since mid-July, before recovering to around $64,600. About $2 billion of mostly leveraged long crypto positions were liquidated in 24 hours, and US spot bitcoin ETFs lost nearly $3 billion from October 30 to November 13. Ether dropped to about $1,711.
stories.why_it_matters: The slide, about 25% since October 21, shows risk appetite fading as investors brace for higher US rates.
stories.note: Low and liquidation figures from Investing.com citing Coinglass; current price from CoinGecko.

impact.why: Forced selling and ETF outflows keep pressure on bitcoin and ether.
